title: The SCUBA-2 Cosmology Legacy Survey: ALMA Resolves the Rest-frame Far-infrared Emission of Sub-millimeter Galaxies
question: What are the size and morphology of the 870 um dust continuum emission of bright SMGs on 2-10 kpc scales, and how do they compare with sizes at other wavelengths and with quiescent galaxies?

data.sensitivity: median rms 0.21 mJy/beam (0.19–0.24) in high-res maps; 0.26 mJy/beam in 0.8'' maps

what.value: HST H-band sizes of ALESS SMGs (17 selected)

evidence.quote: we have restricted their sample to the 17 SMGs with an apparent $H$–band magnitude $<$ $24$ mag
a sample of 12 SMGs (median $S_{850}$ = 6.8 $\pm$ 0.6 mJy) with deconvolved sizes measured from $0.5''$ resolution 1.4 GHz/VLA imaging (cite: Biggs08)
present a compilation (including new observations) of the sizes of SMGs measured from resolved $^{12}$ CO
presented a compilation of $<1$ kpc resolution interferometric imaging (new and archival) of $^{12}$CO
by combining the samples presented by (cite: vandokkum08) and (cite: Krogager13)

recipe.method: Clean to produce 0.3'' high-res and 0.8'' detection maps; select >4σ sources; measure peak and 0.8'' aperture flux
Split-in-time imaging of UDS 204.0, phase calibrator size test, and 20,000 injected Gaussian simulations
key_parameters: SNR>=10 required for 68% of sources recovered with fractional size error <30%

recipe.method: imfit elliptical Gaussian per SMG in 0.3'' maps; uv-plane amplitude fits for 8 isolated SMGs; stacking of faint SMGs with bootstrap errors
key_parameters: free parameters: position, peak flux, major/minor axis, PA

recipe.goal: Convert to physical sizes and compare with other wavelengths
recipe.method: Use photometric redshifts to convert; compare with radio, CO, HST, local U/LIRG sizes
Test galfit recovery on 4000 injected models; stack 23 SMGs and fit Sérsic
SFR from L_FIR (Salpeter IMF), halved for half-light radius, divided by area of uniform disc; compare to Eddington limit of Andrews & Thompson

answer_key.quantity: median intrinsic angular FWHM, SNR>10 SMGs

evidence.quote: median intrinsic angular size of FWHM = $0.30 \pm 0.04''$ for the 23 SMGs
the median physical size of the SMGs is $2.4 \pm 0.2$ kpc (FWHM of the major axis)
We derive sizes of 0.30 $\pm$ 0.07$''$ and 0.35$_{-0.10}^{+0.17}$$''$ for the two sub-samples respectively.
Sérsic index of $n$ = 2.5 $\pm$ 0.4 and a half-light radius of $R_{\rm e}$ = 0.17 $\pm$ 0.03$''$
the SMGs have a median $R_{\rm e} = 1.2 \pm 0.1$ kpc in the sub–millimeter
